hook.text: Freddie Hubbard, Herbie Hancock, Ron Carter and Joe Chambers played on this record at Van Gelder Studio in Englewood Cliffs, NJ.

facts.label: Recorded
facts.value: 21 May 1965, Van Gelder Studio, Englewood Cliffs, NJ

facts.label: Players
facts.value: Sam Rivers (tenor saxophone, soprano saxophone, flute), Freddie Hubbard (trumpet), Herbie Hancock (piano), Ron Carter (bass), Joe Chambers (drums)

listen_for.text: The CD reissue adds an alternate take of this track as a bonus.
